svg.aria-label: Four working rules and the evidence behind each: test counts re-derived from the suite rather than written by hand, hermetic CI where suites run offline, READMEs that list known limits including a measured upscale stall and a deliberately-absent column, and licenses checked down the dependency tree where rembg's CC-BY-NC default model was caught and refused unless knowingly opted into.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every count in these READMEs is re-derived from the suite. This pass found four that had

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drifted: 44 to 62, 56 to 58, 37 to 38, 82 to 85 - and corrected them.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Suites run offline; a CDN outage cannot redden a build. kalp-animasyon bundles its own

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three.js fixture rather than fetching one at test time.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Known limits are listed, not hidden: a measured 7-minute upscale stall on integrated

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: graphics, a gateway column headed 'deliberately absent', voice cloning left out on purpose.

svg.text: rembg's default model is CC-BY-NC - caught by reading the dependency tree, and refused

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: unless you opt in knowingly. buradane splits ODbL data from MIT code in a NOTICE file.
